key_finding: Anomaly hunting did NOT escape combination-saturation. Famous anomalies attract a dense thicket of explanation attempts, so their explanation space is saturated too: 7/9 already explained (fail Gate 3), the 2 genuinely contested ones have crowded competing proposals where any new mechanism collides (fail Gate 4). The Vera-Rubin signature (real AND unexplained AND no-mechanism-yet-proposed) requires a freshly-reported, not-yet-famous discrepancy, which is structurally hard to surface by search (search ranks the famous).
